name: Reaches toward camera
text: She reaches her right hand forward toward the camera.
desc: Appeal, accusation, or a grab. Breaks the fourth wall by pushing through it.
needs: a person in frame with a visible hand
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds. Motion 1.876/2.231/0.713 - above the ceiling on two seeds and INSIDE the do-nothing band on the third. Where it fires it fires well: on 7701 the palm comes up toward the lens by f82 and the framing tightens with it (creep 1.23). Fires 2/3, so do not rely on it for a beat that must land. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
